ex.s: AI transforms a standard museum trip into a personalized and interactive adventure.
ex.t: 人工智能把一次普通的博物馆之行变成个性化、互动性的探索体验。

ex.s: Beyond visitor interaction, AI plays a crucial role in preserving priceless artworks.
ex.t: 除了访客互动，人工智能在保护无价艺术品方面也发挥着关键作用。

ex.s: Museums are working together with AI ethicists to develop fair algorithms.
ex.t: 博物馆正与人工智能伦理学家合作，开发公平的算法。

ex.s: In short, AI is redefining the museum in all respects.
ex.t: 简而言之，人工智能正在从各个方面重新定义博物馆。

ex.s: The fake reviews written for Azimi’s study were put together by humans, but increasingly, fake reviews are being written by AI, which makes them look more real.
ex.t: Azimi研究中使用的虚假评论由真人编写，但越来越多的虚假评论正由人工智能撰写，这使它们看起来更加真实。

ex.s: To design these climate-saving plants, the scientists are using a research tool called SLEAP — an AI software that tracks multiple features of root growth.
ex.t: 为了设计这些拯救气候的植物，科学家们正在使用一种名为SLEAP的研究工具——一款追踪根系生长多项特征的AI软件。

ex.s: SLEAP uses computer vision (the ability for computers to understand images) and deep learning (an AI approach for training a computer to learn and work like the human brain) to help researchers process images much more quickly.
ex.t: SLEAP使用计算机视觉（计算机理解图像的能力）和深度学习（一种训练计算机像人脑一样学习和工作的AI方法），帮助研究者更快地处理图像。

ex.s: Given the astonishing potential of AI to transform our lives, we all need to take action to deal with our AI-powered future, and this is where AI by Design: A Plan for Living with Artificial Intelligence comes in.
ex.t: 鉴于AI改变我们生活的惊人潜力，我们都需要采取行动来应对这个由AI驱动的未来，而这正是《AI by Design：与人工智能共处之计》一书的用武之地。

ex.s: She writes from the practical angle of a business person rather than as an academic, making for a guide which is highly accessible and informative and which, by the close, will make you feel almost as smart as AI.
ex.t: 她从一个商人的实用角度而非学者角度写作，使这本指南极易读又有信息量，读到最后会让你觉得自己几乎和AI一样聪明。

ex.s: As we soon come to learn from AI by Design AI is already super-smart and will become more capable, moving from the current generation of “narrow-AI” to Artificial General Intelligence.
ex.t: 正如我们很快就能从《设计人工智能》中了解到的那样，人工智能已经超级聪明，并且将变得更强大，从当前的“狭义人工智能”发展到通用人工智能。

ex.s: This is why Campbell has set out to raise awareness of AI and its future now — several decades before these developments are expected to take place.
ex.t: 这就是为什么坎贝尔现在就开始提高人们对人工智能及其未来的认识——比这些发展预计发生的时间早了几十年。

ex.s: She says it is essential that we keep control of artificial intelligence, or risk being sidelined and perhaps even worse.
ex.t: 她说，我们必须始终掌控人工智能，否则就有被边缘化甚至更糟的风险。

ex.s: Campbell’s point is to wake up those responsible for AI—the technology companies and world leaders—so they are on the same page as all the experts currently developing it.
ex.t: 坎贝尔的目的是唤醒那些对人工智能负责的人——科技公司和世界领导人——让他们与目前开发人工智能的所有专家达成共识。

ex.s: We need to consider how we want our future with AI to pan out.
ex.t: 我们需要思考希望我们与人工智能的未来如何展开。

ex.s: AI will affect us all, and if you only read one book on the subject, this is it.
ex.t: 人工智能将影响我们所有人，如果你只读一本关于这个主题的书，那就是这本。

ex.s: What is a feature of AI by Design according to the text?
ex.t: 根据文本，《AI by Design》有什么特点？

ex.s: It is intended for AI professionals.
ex.t: 它面向人工智能专业人士。

ex.s: What does Campbell urge people to do regarding AI development?
ex.t: 关于人工智能发展，坎贝尔呼吁人们做什么？

ex.s: To recommend a book on AI.
ex.t: 推荐一本关于AI的书。

ex.s: To give a brief account of AI history.
ex.t: 简要介绍AI的历史。

ex.s: To clarify the definition of AI.
ex.t: 阐明人工智能的定义。

ex.s: To honor an outstanding AI expert.
ex.t: 致敬一位杰出的AI专家。

ex.s: In the Digital Age, we’re used to having what we need immediately and right ai our fingertips.
ex.t: 在数字时代，我们习惯了立刻就能得到满足，所需之物尽在指尖。

ex.s: And that’s why, however astonishing Project Debater may seem, the tradition that began with Socrates and Confucius will not end with artificial intelligence.
ex.t: 正因如此，无论Project Debater多么惊人，始于苏格拉底和孔子的传统不会随人工智能终结。

ex.s: Artificial intelligence ensures humans a bright future.
ex.t: 人工智能确保人类拥有光明未来。

ex.s: ALife and AI share a common feature.
ex.t: ALife与AI有一个共同特征。

ex.s: AI mirrors the developments of ALife.
ex.t: AI反映了ALife的发展。

ex.s: AI speeds up the process of human evolution.
ex.t: AI加速了人类进化的过程。

ex.s: Can AI Be a Way Out?
ex.t: AI能成为出路吗？

ex.s: Can AI Help ALife Evolve, Too?
ex.t: AI也能帮助ALife进化吗？

ex.s: Very small drones with advanced sensors and AI and travelling ahead of the train could guide it like a co-pilot.
ex.t: 带有先进传感器和AI、在火车前方行驶的小型无人机，可以像副驾驶一样为它引路。

ex.s: But using machine learning and artificial intelligence, some scientists propose that human diets consist of at least 26,000 biochemicals—and that the vast majority are not known.This shows that we have some way to travel before achieving the first objective of systems thinking - which, in this example, is to identify more constituent parts of the nutrition system.
ex.t: 但利用机器学习和人工智能，一些科学家提出，人类饮食至少包含 26,000 种生化物质——而其中绝大多数尚不为人知。这表明，在实现系统思维的第一个目标之前，我们还有很长的路要走——在这个例子中，该目标就是识别营养系统中更多的组成部分。

ex.s: What will remain of us when artificial intelligence takes over will be our creativity, and it is our creative spirit, our visionary sense of freshness,that has been our strength for centuries."
ex.t: “当人工智能接管一切后，留给我们的将是创造力，而正是我们的创造精神、我们对新鲜事物的远见，几个世纪以来一直是我们的力量所在。”

ex.s: Certain forms of AI are indeed becoming ubiquitous.
ex.t: 某些形式的人工智能确实正在变得无处不在。

ex.s: Some of today's AI pioneers want to move on from today's world of “weak” or “narrow” AI, to create “strong” or “full” AI, or what is often called artificial general intelligence（A GI）.
ex.t: 当今一些人工智能先驱想要摆脱“弱”或“窄”人工智能的当下，去创造“强”或“全”人工智能，即常被称为通用人工智能（AGI）的东西。

ex.s: Since the early days of AI, imagination has outpaced what is possible or even probable.
ex.t: 从人工智能早期开始，想象力就一直超越可能甚至可行的范围。

ex.s: And, having spoken to many of the world's foremost AI researchers, I believe there is good reason to doubt that we will see A GI any time soon, if ever:
ex.t: 而且，在和世界上许多顶尖AI研究人员交谈后，我确信有充分理由怀疑我们近期——甚至根本——不会看到AGI出现：

ex.s: The real problem relates to the possibility that artificial intelligence(AI) may become extremely good at achieving something other than what we really want.
ex.t: 真正的问题与这样一种可能性有关：人工智能（AI）可能变得极其擅长实现某些并非我们真正想要的东西。

ex.s: Solving the safety problem well enough to move forward in AI seems to be possible but not easy.
ex.t: 把安全问题解决到足以推动AI发展的程度似乎是可能的，但并不容易。

ex.s: But the problem should not be dismissed out of hand, as it has been by some AI researchers.
ex.t: 但这个问题不应被草率地撇开不理，正如一些AI研究者所做的那样。

ex.s: Still others think that super intelligent AI will never happen.
ex.t: 还有人认为超级智能AI永远不会出现。

ex.s: Paragraph 1 mainly tells us that artificial intelligence may         .
ex.t: 第1段主要告诉我们人工智能可能         。

ex.s: It will disappear with the development of AI.
ex.t: 随着人工智能的发展，它将消失。

ex.s: Emotional quotient (EQ), or emotional intelligence quotient, is a measurement of the ability to recognise one’s own and other people’s emotions.
ex.t: 情商（EQ）是对识别自身和他人情绪能力的衡量。

ex.s: It is believed that EQ plays an even more important role than IQ (intelligence quotient) in people’s lives.
ex.t: 人们认为，情商在人们的生活中起着比智商（智商）更重要的作用。

ex.s: Being able to say no politely is one of the features of emotional intelligence.
ex.t: 能够礼貌地说“不”是情商的特征之一。

ex.s: However, sending people there will require all the skill, courage and intelligence of the human race.
ex.t: 但是，派人去那里需要人类所有的技能、勇气和智慧。

ex.s: Milestones in Artificial Intelligence (AI) 1950 Mathematician and logician, Alan Turing devised the Turing Test, a test on the ability of machines to show human-like intelligence.
ex.t: 1950年人工智能（ AI ）的里程碑数学家和逻辑学家艾伦·图灵（ Alan Turing ）设计了图灵测试（ Turing Test ） ，这是对机器展示类似人类智能的能力的测试。
